_about: The Poetic Edda in Henry Adams Bellows's translation (American-Scandinavian Foundation, 1923), as the relay asked: published 1923, US public domain since 2019. Clean Gutenberg text, translator in the title. Two more translations were added later: Thorpe and Blackwell's Eddas (PG 14726) and Magnússon and Morris's Volsunga Saga (PG 1152). Widened at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: Lane D chooses its own batches; Adam may veto).

edda-bellows: The Poetic Edda, tr. Henry Adams Bellows (1923)
edda-thorpe-blackwell: The Elder Eddas of Saemund Sigfusson, tr. Benjamin Thorpe, and the Younger Eddas of Snorre Sturleson, tr. I. A. Blackwell (Norrœna Society, 1906)
edda-volsunga-morris: The Story of the Volsungs (Volsunga Saga), with Excerpts from the Poetic Edda, tr. Eiríkr Magnússon and William Morris

_excluded.edda-retellings: Faraday's The Edda (PG 13007-13008), Wilmot-Buxton (29551): studies and retellings; Guerber's Myths of the Norsemen (28497) is held on guerber_shelf.json
_excluded.edda-prose: Snorri's Prose (Younger) Edda is on the Sturluson shelf
